Newton printed the hymn under Matthew 15:22–28. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

22And a Canaanite woman from that region came to Him, crying out, “Lord, Son of David, have mercy on me! My daughter is miserably possessed by a demon.” 23But Jesus did not answer a word. So His disciples came and urged Him, “Send her away, for she keeps crying out after us.” 24He answered, “I was sent only to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.” 25The woman came and knelt before Him. “Lord, help me!” she said. 26But Jesus replied, “It is not right to take the children’s bread and toss it to the dogs.” 27“Yes, Lord,” she said, “even the dogs eat the crumbs that fall from their master’s table.” 28“O woman,” Jesus answered, “your faith is great! Let it be done for you as you desire.” And her daughter was healed from that very hour. MATTHEW 15:22–28 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ MATTHEW 15
Jesus then his heart revealed, “Woman canst thou thus believe? I to thy petition yield, All that thou canst wish, receive. STANZA VII
